model.background: E(a)^2 = Om a^-3 + Ok a^-2 + Ode a^(-3(1+w)), Ok = 1 - Om - Ode, a = 1/(1+z), w constant; radiation is not in the perturbation equation and Or must be 0 (refusal 'radiation-in-growth')
model.growthEquation: in u = ln a, with primes d/du:  D'' + (2 + dlnE/du) D' - (3/2) Omega_m(a) D = 0,  Omega_m(a) = Om a^-3 / E(a)^2,  dlnE/du = [-3 Om a^-3 - 2 Ok a^-2 - 3 (1+w) Ode a^(-3(1+w))] / (2 E^2). Linear perturbations of pressureless matter, sub-horizon, general relativity, a smooth (unclustered) dark energy with constant w. The growth rate is f = dlnD/du = D'/D.
model.normalisation: D is the growing mode normalised to D -> a in the matter era (so D(a) = a for Om = 1); the kernel starts at a_i = 1e-6 with D = a_i (1 - (4/7)(Ok/Om) a_i) and D' = a_i (1 - (8/7)(Ok/Om) a_i), the first-order matter-era series with the curvature term (derived in GROWTH_GATE.md section 2 and tested by leg G1 to G4 and O1, not assumed)
model.growthDomain: Om in [0.1, 1]; Ode in [0, 1.2]; w in [-1.5, -0.5]; Or = 0; scale factor a in [0.01, 1] (z up to 99). Linear scales only. A set that breaks a rule is refused with a code and no number is returned. Codes in the order they are judged: not-finite, bad-argument, radiation-in-growth, density-out-of-domain, w-out-of-domain, bounce; at the call: a-out-of-domain.
model.numerics: the kernel integrates the equation with an embedded Dormand-Prince 5(4) pair in u (relative tolerance 1e-11) with the sum of the accepted steps' error estimates carried beside every output, plus the initial-condition truncation term (K a_i)^2 + (Ode/Om) a_i^(-3w) with K = |Ok|/Om; it is an estimate, not a bound, and leg O2 tests whether it covers. 152 (js/numeric) has no ODE routine: this is the delta table's missing behaviour, recorded as decision DEC2, and the integrator is a private function of the prototype, not an extraction.
model.shape: Eisenstein and Hu 1998, equations (28) to (31) with s from (26): the zero-baryon form T0(q) = L0/(L0 + C0 q^2) with L0 = ln(2e + 1.8 q) and C0 = 14.2 + 731/(1 + 62.5 q), applied at q_eff = (k/(h Mpc^-1)) Theta_2.7^2 / Gamma_eff with Gamma_eff(k) = Om h (alpha_Gamma + (1 - alpha_Gamma)/(1 + (0.43 k s)^4)), alpha_Gamma = 1 - 0.328 ln(431 Om h^2) (Ob/Om) + 0.38 ln(22.3 Om h^2) (Ob/Om)^2, s = 44.5 ln(9.83/(Om h^2)) / sqrt(1 + 10 (Ob h^2)^(3/4)) Mpc, and k s read with k in Mpc^-1 (the printed s is in Mpc); T(k) = T0(q_eff). The coefficients are transcribed from the saved text into authentic/eh98-formulas.json by hand with the line of the text beside each token, and the test checks every token against the saved text's sha256 (the text itself is not in the repository). Theta_2.7 = 2.728/2.7, the value the paper prints for the COBE temperature. Baryon acoustic oscillations are not modelled (the no-wiggle form).
model.shapeDomain: h in [0.3, 1.2]; Om h^2 in [0.025, 0.5] and Ob h^2 >= 0.0125 (the range over which the paper states its sound-horizon fit holds to about 2 percent); Ob/Om <= 0.5 (the paper says the neglect of the oscillations is not a good approximation above about that); spectral index ns in [0.5, 1.5]; sigma8 in (0, 3]; k in [1e-5, 1e4] h/Mpc; R in [0.1, 1000] Mpc/h. Codes in order: not-finite, bad-argument, h-out-of-domain, omega-m-h2, omega-b-h2, baryon-fraction, ns-out-of-domain, sigma8-out-of-domain; at the call: k-out-of-domain, R-out-of-domain. Neutrino mass, the oscillations and any tensor or running term are not modelled.
model.variance: sigma^2(R) = Integral_0^inf (dk/k) Delta^2(k) [3 j1(kR)/(kR)]^2 (the printed form A7, whose j1 differs from the usual sign and is squared), Delta^2(k) = N k^(3+ns) T(k)^2, N fixed by sigma(8 Mpc/h) = sigma8 (a declared INPUT, never a measurement), k in h/Mpc, R in Mpc/h; sigma(R, a) = sigma(R, 1) D(a)/D(1). The kernel integrates in ln k over [1e-5, 1e4] h/Mpc with 152's adaptive quadrature on 200 equal panels.
model.jeans: A single pressure-supported fluid in the expanding background, Newtonian and sub-horizon, constant sound speed c_s as an INPUT (no thermal history, no gas temperature, no baryon-dark matter two-fluid coupling): D'' + (2 + dlnE/du) D' + [ (c_s k / (H0 a E))^2 - (3/2) Omega_m(a) ] D = 0, the comoving Jeans wavenumber k_J(a) = sqrt(3 Omega_m(a)/2) a E H0 / c_s (c_s in km/s, H0 in km/s/Mpc, k in 1/Mpc), growth for k < k_J and oscillation for k > k_J. The kernel takes its initial data from the same matter-era series as the pressureless equation; the legs compare solutions of the stated equation with the stated data. Domain: c_s in (0, 100] km/s, k in (0, 1e4] 1/Mpc; codes not-finite, bad-sound-speed, bad-wavenumber. Not modelled: dark-matter free streaming, the baryon Jeans mass of the real gas (it needs the thermal history), relativistic pressure.
model.imagery: NONE. No simulation release is named, none was fetched, no rights decision exists for any, and the contract's slices need one per source and per redistribution form (7.5 rule 4).
